note: SNG-663 §1 content gap (CCODE-549 §381): the three LEGENDARY claimants cannot finish. Cause, measured: each has TWO records. The tradition_epics row carries an arcAffinity; the npcs/<id>.json file does not, and the npc file is what the game reads, so the row is shadowed and the claimant pushes nothing. Two rows also lean -1, and a claimant leaning DOWN an arc can never reach its last rung. Fix: put the affinity on the npc file (the live one), every claimant leaning +1 on the arc its finish is, and bring the shadowed rows into agreement so they can't mislead the next reader. ⬜ CCode: these are NEW pushes on live arcs (today these three push nothing). Measure the four arcs' stage over a simulated year before and after, then apply with the result. The storm is the one to watch: Cinder Vael +3 and the Scouring Hand +3 against the Last Mercy's -2.

claimants.why: Her finish is the Sealing: the wood closed and humankind out. Unchanged from her shadowed row; it just never reached the game.

Flipped from -1. It wants everything unmade, and a world remaking its furniture faster than it can be named is a world unmaking its old furniture faster than anyone can grieve it. It feeds the churn, not the new ground; its finish is the storm at full height, where nothing that was stays. Cinder Vael rides the same arc for the opposite reason, and the Last Mercy holds against both.

Flipped from -1. Stage 3 of the Bleeding Grammar is the Resolve: the crossing settles into a new stable form, or unravels. The Still Lattice drives it there so that it settles, in its form, once and forever. Holding the bleed back would leave the world moving; resolving it is the single correct configuration. This is the open seat's only claimant, so this is the row that makes the most dangerous seat in the world finishable.
